_comment: External helpers bin/init.sh detects and suggests (lib/suggest.py). Commands are data: suggest.py never runs an install command, never writes a global file, and reads the global configs in detect.mcp_server.global only with --read-global-config. detect keys: binary (on PATH), probe (argv that must exit 0), version (argv, regex, min), config_flag (dotted key in <tools>/config/project.json that must be true), mcp_server (server key looked up in the repo-local files, and in the global ones only with the flag), status (read-only argv whose first line is appended to why). command keys: install (when the binary is missing), claude / pi (per runtime, when the entry is missing; all replaces both for --runtime all when present), config (when only config_flag fails), mcp (when only the MCP server is missing). Placeholders: <repo>, <tools>. verified=false marks a command that could not be checked on the authoring machine.

suggestions.why: Persistent memory: lib/engram_bridge.py saves every finalized receipt and every handoff (topic keys metodo/receipt/<tree>, metodo/handoff/<round>/<role>), so later sessions can find what earlier ones concluded
suggestions.source: engram v3.4.0 `engram --help` and `engram setup --help` (setup agents: opencode, pi, claude-code); `brew info gentleman-programming/tap/engram`; checked 2026-10-15

suggestions.why: Up-to-date library documentation for the agents through MCP, instead of what the model remembers about an API

command.claude: claude mcp add --scope project context7 -- npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp
command.pi: add "context7": {"command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@upstash/context7-mcp"]} under mcpServers in <repo>/.mcp.json (pi reads the same file)
command.all: claude mcp add --scope project context7 -- npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp (writes <repo>/.mcp.json, which pi reads too)

suggestions.source: Context7 README (github.com/upstash/context7) for the npm package @upstash/context7-mcp; `claude mcp add --help` for the --scope / -- syntax; the package name was not checked against the npm registry

suggestions.why: Its receipt-driven review can run beside the kit; config/project.json rdd.review_authority decides which one owns the review (00-principles/runtime-adapters.md section 4)
suggestions.source: `brew info gentleman-programming/tap/gentle-ai`; gentle-ai 4.1.1 `gentle-ai --help` (review mode status is read-only); checked 2026-10-15

suggestions.why: GitHub pull requests and review comments from the terminal; `gh pr create` / `gh pr merge` is what the kit's PR gate (hooks/guard_gates.py gate-pr) intercepts. The kit's own comment poster (lib/review_comment_post.py) targets Bitbucket, not GitHub

command.install: brew install gh && gh auth login

suggestions.source: `brew info gh`; GitHub CLI manual for `gh auth login`; checked 2026-10-15

suggestions.why: Runs the vendored jars bin/fetch-tools.sh pins (detekt, PMD CPD for duplication and its calibration, ktlint); without it duplication falls back to a line-hash heuristic
